1812
1813def set_circuit_rounds(circuit: Any, rounds: int) -> Any:
1814 """Sets the repeat_count of CircuitRepeatBlocks in a Stim circuit.
1815
1816 For circuits with a single repeat block, sets its repeat_count to rounds.
1817 For circuits with two repeat blocks (e.g. preamble + periodic body),
1818 adjusts them to achieve total requested rounds.
1819
1820 Args:
1821 circuit: A stim.Circuit instance.
1822 rounds: The new repetition count to set for repeat blocks. If <= 0,
1823 repeat blocks are omitted.
1824
1825 Returns:
1826 A new stim.Circuit instance with modified repeat counts.
1827 """
1828 stim = _get_stim()
1829 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
1830 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
1831 if not isinstance(circuit, stim.Circuit):
1832 return circuit
1833 if rounds < 0:
1834 raise ValueError(f"Invalid rounds={rounds}; must be >= 0.")
1835
1836 top_blocks = [
1837 inst.repeat_count for inst in circuit
1838 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock)
1839 ]
1840 if len(top_blocks) > 1:
1841 sys.stderr.write(
1842 f"# Warning: Circuit has {len(top_blocks)} repeat blocks "
1843 f"({top_blocks}) which may not be handled correctly by this "
1844 "script.\n"
1845 )
1846
1847 new_circuit = stim.Circuit()
1848 if len(top_blocks) == 2:
1849 preamble = top_blocks[0]
1850 b1_count = min(preamble, rounds)
1851 b2_count = max(0, rounds - preamble)
1852 block_idx = 0
1853 for inst in circuit:
1854 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
1855 cnt = b1_count if block_idx == 0 else b2_count
1856 block_idx += 1
1857 if cnt > 0:
1858 new_body = set_circuit_rounds(inst.body_copy(), cnt)
1859 new_circuit.append(stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(cnt, new_body))
1860 else:
1861 new_circuit.append(inst)
1862 else:
1863 for inst in circuit:
1864 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
1865 if rounds > 0:
1866 new_body = set_circuit_rounds(inst.body_copy(), rounds)
1867 new_circuit.append(
1868 stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(rounds, new_body)
1869 )
1870 else:
1871 new_circuit.append(inst)
1872 return new_circuit
1873
1874
1875def count_circuit_rounds(circuit: Any) -> int:
1876 """Returns total repeat count of all repeat blocks in circuit, or 1 if unrolled."""
1877 stim = _get_stim()
1878 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
1879 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
1880 if not isinstance(circuit, stim.Circuit):
1881 return 1
1882 blocks = [
1883 inst.repeat_count for inst in circuit
1884 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock)
1885 ]
1886 if len(blocks) > 1:
1887 sys.stderr.write(
1888 f"# Warning: Circuit has {len(blocks)} repeat blocks "
1889 f"({blocks}) which may not be handled correctly by this "
1890 "script.\n"
1891 )
1892 return sum(blocks) if blocks else 1
1893
1894
1895def detect_basis(
1896 circuit: Any,
1897 filepath: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
1898 basis_arg: Optional[str] = None
1899) -> str:
1900 """Determines the primary memory basis ('X' or 'Z') of a Stim circuit."""
1901 if basis_arg is not None and str(basis_arg).upper() in ["X", "Z"]:
1902 return str(basis_arg).upper()
1903
1904 if filepath is not None:
1905 stem = Path(filepath).stem.upper()
1906 parts = stem.replace("-", "_").split("_")
1907 if "X" in parts or "HX" in parts or stem.endswith("X"):
1908 return "X"
1909 if "Z" in parts or "HZ" in parts or stem.endswith("Z"):
1910 return "Z"
1911
1912 stim = _get_stim()
1913 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
1914 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
1915
1916 rx_count = 0
1917 rz_count = 0
1918 for inst in circuit:
1919 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
1920 break
1921 if inst.name == "RX":
1922 rx_count += len(inst.targets_copy())
1923 elif inst.name in ["R", "RZ"]:
1924 rz_count += len(inst.targets_copy())
1925 elif inst.name in ["M", "MX", "MZ", "MR", "MRX", "MRZ"]:
1926 break
1927 if rx_count > rz_count:
1928 return "X"
1929 if rz_count > rx_count:
1930 return "Z"
1931
1932 mx_count = 0
1933 mz_count = 0
1934 for inst in reversed(list(circuit)):
1935 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
1936 break
1937 if inst.name in ["MX", "MRX"]:
1938 mx_count += len(inst.targets_copy())
1939 elif inst.name in ["M", "MZ", "MR", "MRZ"]:
1940 mz_count += len(inst.targets_copy())
1941 if mx_count > mz_count:
1942 return "X"
1943 return "Z"
1944
1945
1946def track_circuit_carriers(circuit: Any) -> List[List[int]]:
1947 """Dynamically tracks logical syndrome carriers across the circuit to measurements.
1948
1949 Accounts for physical qubit permutations via SWAP, CXSWAP, CZSWAP, ISWAP,
1950 and ISWAP_DAG gates, as well as CNOT/CZ syndrome handoffs onto fresh ancilla
1951 or routing qubits.
1952
1953 Returns:
1954 meas_carriers: List mapping each measurement index to a list of initial
1955 logical qubit IDs whose syndrome or state is carried into that
1956 measurement.
1957 """
1958 stim = _get_stim()
1959 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
1960 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
1961 num_qubits = circuit.num_qubits
1962 phys_to_log = {q: q for q in range(num_qubits)}
1963
1964 tot_resets: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in range(num_qubits)}
1965 tot_meas: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in range(num_qubits)}
1966
1967 def pass1(block: Any, p_to_l: Dict[int, int], mult: int = 1) -> None:
1968 for inst in block:
1969 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
1970 rep_count = inst.repeat_count
1971 body = inst.body_copy()
1972 map_copy = dict(p_to_l)
1973 for sub_inst in body:
1974 if not isinstance(sub_inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
1975 if sub_inst.name in [
1976 "SWAP", "CXSWAP", "CZSWAP", "ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG"
1977 ]:
1978 t_vals = [
1979 t.value for t in sub_inst.targets_copy()
1980 if t.is_qubit_target
1981 ]
1982 for idx in range(0, len(t_vals), 2):
1983 q1, q2 = t_vals[idx], t_vals[idx + 1]
1984 map_copy[q1], map_copy[q2] = (
1985 map_copy[q2], map_copy[q1]
1986 )
1987 if map_copy == p_to_l:
1988 pass1(body, p_to_l, mult * rep_count)
1989 else:
1990 for _ in range(rep_count):
1991 pass1(body, p_to_l, mult)
1992 continue
1993 name = inst.name
1994 t_vals = [
1995 t.value for t in inst.targets_copy() if t.is_qubit_target
1996 ]
1997 if name in [
1998 "R", "RX", "RY", "RZ", "MR", "MRX", "MRY", "MRZ"
1999 ]:
2000 for q in t_vals:
2001 tot_resets[p_to_l[q]] += mult
2002 if name in [
2003 "M", "MX", "MY", "MZ", "MR", "MRX", "MRY", "MRZ"
2004 ]:
2005 for q in t_vals:
2006 tot_meas[p_to_l[q]] += mult
2007 if name in ["SWAP", "CXSWAP", "CZSWAP", "ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG"]:
2008 for idx in range(0, len(t_vals), 2):
2009 q1, q2 = t_vals[idx], t_vals[idx + 1]
2010 p_to_l[q1], p_to_l[q2] = p_to_l[q2], p_to_l[q1]
2011
2012 pass1(circuit, dict(phys_to_log), 1)
2013 max_resets = max(tot_resets.values()) if tot_resets else 0
2014 max_meas = max(tot_meas.values()) if tot_meas else 0
2015 data_log = set()
2016 for q in range(num_qubits):
2017 if max_resets > 1:
2018 if tot_resets[q] <= 1:
2019 data_log.add(q)
2020 elif max_meas > 1:
2021 if tot_meas[q] <= 1:
2022 data_log.add(q)
2023
2024 active_carriers: Dict[int, Set[int]] = {
2025 q: {q} for q in range(num_qubits)
2026 }
2027 fresh_anc: Set[int] = set(range(num_qubits)) - data_log
2028 meas_carriers: List[List[int]] = []
2029
2030 def pass2(block: Any, p_to_l: Dict[int, int]) -> None:
2031 for inst in block:
2032 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
2033 rep_count = inst.repeat_count
2034 body = inst.body_copy()
2035 if rep_count <= 0:
2036 continue
2037 map_copy = dict(p_to_l)
2038 for sub_inst in body:
2039 if not isinstance(sub_inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
2040 if sub_inst.name in [
2041 "SWAP", "CXSWAP", "CZSWAP", "ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG"
2042 ]:
2043 t_vals = [
2044 t.value for t in sub_inst.targets_copy()
2045 if t.is_qubit_target
2046 ]
2047 for idx in range(0, len(t_vals), 2):
2048 q1, q2 = t_vals[idx], t_vals[idx + 1]
2049 map_copy[q1], map_copy[q2] = (
2050 map_copy[q2], map_copy[q1]
2051 )
2052 if map_copy == p_to_l:
2053 idx0 = len(meas_carriers)
2054 pass2(body, p_to_l)
2055 idx1 = len(meas_carriers)
2056 if rep_count > 1 and idx1 > idx0:
2057 body_carriers = meas_carriers[idx0:idx1]
2058 meas_carriers.extend(body_carriers * (rep_count - 1))
2059 else:
2060 for _ in range(rep_count):
2061 pass2(body, p_to_l)
2062 continue
2063 name = inst.name
2064 t_vals = [
2065 t.value for t in inst.targets_copy() if t.is_qubit_target
2066 ]
2067 if name in ["R", "RX", "RY", "RZ"]:
2068 for q in t_vals:
2069 lq = p_to_l[q]
2070 active_carriers[lq] = {lq}
2071 if lq not in data_log:
2072 fresh_anc.add(lq)
2073 elif name in ["M", "MX", "MY", "MZ"]:
2074 for q in t_vals:
2075 lq = p_to_l[q]
2076 meas_carriers.append(sorted(list(active_carriers[lq])))
2077 elif name in ["MR", "MRX", "MRY", "MRZ"]:
2078 for q in t_vals:
2079 lq = p_to_l[q]
2080 meas_carriers.append(sorted(list(active_carriers[lq])))
2081 active_carriers[lq] = {lq}
2082 if lq not in data_log:
2083 fresh_anc.add(lq)
2084 elif name in [
2085 "CX", "ZCX", "CY", "ZCY", "CZ", "ZCZ",
2086 "XCX", "XCY", "XCZ", "YCX", "YCY", "YCZ"
2087 ]:
2088 for idx in range(0, len(t_vals), 2):
2089 q1, q2 = t_vals[idx], t_vals[idx + 1]
2090 l1, l2 = p_to_l[q1], p_to_l[q2]
2091 if l1 not in data_log and l2 not in data_log:
2092 if l2 in fresh_anc and l1 not in fresh_anc:
2093 active_carriers[l2] = set(active_carriers[l1])
2094 fresh_anc.discard(l2)
2095 elif l1 in fresh_anc and l2 not in fresh_anc:
2096 active_carriers[l1] = set(active_carriers[l2])
2097 fresh_anc.discard(l1)
2098 else:
2099 comb = active_carriers[l1] | active_carriers[l2]
2100 active_carriers[l1] = set(comb)
2101 active_carriers[l2] = set(comb)
2102 fresh_anc.discard(l1)
2103 fresh_anc.discard(l2)
2104 elif l1 in data_log and l2 not in data_log:
2105 fresh_anc.discard(l2)
2106 elif l2 in data_log and l1 not in data_log:
2107 fresh_anc.discard(l1)
2108 elif name == "SWAP":
2109 for idx in range(0, len(t_vals), 2):
2110 q1, q2 = t_vals[idx], t_vals[idx + 1]
2111 p_to_l[q1], p_to_l[q2] = p_to_l[q2], p_to_l[q1]
2112 elif name in ["CXSWAP", "CZSWAP", "ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG"]:
2113 for idx in range(0, len(t_vals), 2):
2114 q1, q2 = t_vals[idx], t_vals[idx + 1]
2115 l1, l2 = p_to_l[q1], p_to_l[q2]
2116 if l1 in data_log and l2 not in data_log:
2117 fresh_anc.discard(l2)
2118 elif l2 in data_log and l1 not in data_log:
2119 fresh_anc.discard(l1)
2120 p_to_l[q1], p_to_l[q2] = p_to_l[q2], p_to_l[q1]
2121
2122 pass2(circuit, dict(phys_to_log))
2123 return meas_carriers
2124
2125
2126def _rewrite_circuit_internal(
2127 circ: Any,
2128 phys_to_log: Dict[int, int],
2129 active_gates_count: Dict[int, int]
2130) -> Any:
2131 """Rewrites a Stim circuit by tracking SWAPs virtually."""
2132 stim = _get_stim()
2133 new_circ = stim.Circuit()
2134 non_active_instructions = {
2135 "QUBIT_COORDS", "SHIFT_COORDS", "TICK",
2136 "DETECTOR", "OBSERVABLE_INCLUDE", "MPAD"
2137 }
2138
2139 for inst in circ:
2140 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
2141 rep_count = inst.repeat_count
2142 body = inst.body_copy()
2143 map_copy = dict(phys_to_log)
2144 for sub_inst in body:
2145 if not isinstance(sub_inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
2146 if sub_inst.name in [
2147 "SWAP", "CXSWAP", "CZSWAP", "ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG"
2148 ]:
2149 targets = sub_inst.targets_copy()
2150 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
2151 q1 = targets[idx].value
2152 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
2153 map_copy[q1], map_copy[q2] = (
2154 map_copy[q2], map_copy[q1]
2155 )
2156 if map_copy == phys_to_log:
2157 new_body = _rewrite_circuit_internal(
2158 body, phys_to_log, active_gates_count
2159 )
2160 new_circ.append(stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(rep_count, new_body))
2161 else:
2162 for _ in range(rep_count):
2163 unrolled_body = _rewrite_circuit_internal(
2164 body, phys_to_log, active_gates_count
2165 )
2166 new_circ += unrolled_body
2167 continue
2168
2169 name = inst.name
2170 targets = inst.targets_copy()
2171 args = inst.gate_args_copy()
2172
2173 if name == "SWAP":
2174 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
2175 q1 = targets[idx].value
2176 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
2177 phys_to_log[q1], phys_to_log[q2] = (
2178 phys_to_log[q2], phys_to_log[q1]
2179 )
2180 elif name == "CXSWAP":
2181 cx_targets = []
2182 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
2183 q1 = targets[idx].value
2184 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
2185 l1 = phys_to_log[q1]
2186 l2 = phys_to_log[q2]
2187 cx_targets.extend([l1, l2])
2188 active_gates_count[l1] = active_gates_count.get(l1, 0) + 1
2189 active_gates_count[l2] = active_gates_count.get(l2, 0) + 1
2190 phys_to_log[q1], phys_to_log[q2] = (
2191 phys_to_log[q2], phys_to_log[q1]
2192 )
2193 new_circ.append("CX", cx_targets, args)
2194 elif name == "CZSWAP":
2195 cz_targets = []
2196 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
2197 q1 = targets[idx].value
2198 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
2199 l1 = phys_to_log[q1]
2200 l2 = phys_to_log[q2]
2201 cz_targets.extend([l1, l2])
2202 active_gates_count[l1] = active_gates_count.get(l1, 0) + 1
2203 active_gates_count[l2] = active_gates_count.get(l2, 0) + 1
2204 phys_to_log[q1], phys_to_log[q2] = (
2205 phys_to_log[q2], phys_to_log[q1]
2206 )
2207 new_circ.append("CZ", cz_targets, args)
2208 elif name in ["ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG"]:
2209 cz_targets = []
2210 s_targets = []
2211 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
2212 q1 = targets[idx].value
2213 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
2214 l1 = phys_to_log[q1]
2215 l2 = phys_to_log[q2]
2216 cz_targets.extend([l1, l2])
2217 s_targets.extend([l1, l2])
2218 active_gates_count[l1] = active_gates_count.get(l1, 0) + 1
2219 active_gates_count[l2] = active_gates_count.get(l2, 0) + 1
2220 phys_to_log[q1], phys_to_log[q2] = (
2221 phys_to_log[q2], phys_to_log[q1]
2222 )
2223 new_circ.append("CZ", cz_targets)
2224 s_gate = "S" if name == "ISWAP" else "S_DAG"
2225 new_circ.append(s_gate, s_targets)
2226 else:
2227 new_targets = []
2228 for t in targets:
2229 if t.is_qubit_target:
2230 l_q = phys_to_log[t.value]
2231 if name not in non_active_instructions:
2232 active_gates_count[l_q] = (
2233 active_gates_count.get(l_q, 0) + 1
2234 )
2235 if t.is_inverted_result_target:
2236 new_targets.append(stim.target_inv(l_q))
2237 else:
2238 new_targets.append(l_q)
2239 elif t.is_x_target:
2240 l_q = phys_to_log[t.value]
2241 if name not in non_active_instructions:
2242 active_gates_count[l_q] = (
2243 active_gates_count.get(l_q, 0) + 1
2244 )
2245 new_targets.append(stim.target_x(l_q))
2246 elif t.is_y_target:
2247 l_q = phys_to_log[t.value]
2248 if name not in non_active_instructions:
2249 active_gates_count[l_q] = (
2250 active_gates_count.get(l_q, 0) + 1
2251 )
2252 new_targets.append(stim.target_y(l_q))
2253 elif t.is_z_target:
2254 l_q = phys_to_log[t.value]
2255 if name not in non_active_instructions:
2256 active_gates_count[l_q] = (
2257 active_gates_count.get(l_q, 0) + 1
2258 )
2259 new_targets.append(stim.target_z(l_q))
2260 else:
2261 new_targets.append(t)
2262 new_circ.append(name, new_targets, args)
2263 return new_circ
2264
2265
2266def classify_qubits_thorough(
2267 circuit: Any,
2268 verbose: bool = False,
2269 basis_arg: Optional[str] = None,
2270 filepath: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
2271) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2272 """Classifies qubits and checks via virtual SWAP rewriting and Pauli basis tracking.
2273
2274 Tracks both ancilla stabilizer evolution and data qubit initial basis
2275 evolution through 1-qubit and 2-qubit Clifford gates. Supports standard
2276 CSS codes as well as locally basis-rotated CSS codes (such as XZZX codes)
2277 via 2-coloring of the check-data Pauli compatibility graph.
2278
2279 Returns:
2280 Dictionary with keys:
2281 - 'x_ancillas': Sorted list of X-type (or X-sector) ancilla qubit IDs.
2282 - 'z_ancillas': Sorted list of Z-type (or Z-sector) ancilla qubit IDs.
2283 - 'data_qubits': Sorted list of data qubit IDs.
2284 - 'routing_qubits': Sorted list of idle/routing qubit IDs.
2285 - 'rotated_data_qubits': Sorted list of data qubits with rotated local basis.
2286 - 'is_css': True if the circuit implements a (possibly locally rotated) CSS code.
2287 - 'is_rotated_css': True if CSS only after local data basis rotations (e.g. XZZX).
2288 - 'basis': Primary memory basis ('X' or 'Z').
2289 - 'rewritten_circuit': Circuit with SWAPs virtually eliminated.
2290 """
2291 stim = _get_stim()
2292 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
2293 if filepath is None:
2294 filepath = circuit
2295 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
2296
2297 all_qubits_set: Set[int] = set()
2298
2299 def collect_qubits(blk: Any) -> None:
2300 for inst in blk:
2301 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
2302 collect_qubits(inst.body_copy())
2303 else:
2304 for t in inst.targets_copy():
2305 if (
2306 t.is_qubit_target or t.is_x_target
2307 or t.is_y_target or t.is_z_target
2308 ):
2309 all_qubits_set.add(t.value)
2310
2311 collect_qubits(circuit)
2312 max_q = max(all_qubits_set) if all_qubits_set else -1
2313 phys_to_log = {q: q for q in range(max_q + 1)}
2314 active_gates_count = {q: 0 for q in all_qubits_set}
2315
2316 def cap_repeats(blk: Any) -> Any:
2317 out = stim.Circuit()
2318 for inst in blk:
2319 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
2320 out.append(
2321 stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(
2322 min(inst.repeat_count, 2),
2323 cap_repeats(inst.body_copy())
2324 )
2325 )
2326 else:
2327 out.append(inst)
2328 return out
2329
2330 capped_circuit = cap_repeats(circuit)
2331 rewritten_circ = _rewrite_circuit_internal(
2332 capped_circuit, phys_to_log, active_gates_count
2333 )
2334 routing_qubits = {
2335 q for q, count in active_gates_count.items() if count == 0
2336 }
2337 active_qubits = all_qubits_set - routing_qubits
2338
2339 flat_circ = rewritten_circ.flattened()
2340
2341 tot_resets: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in active_qubits}
2342 tot_meas: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in active_qubits}
2343 meas_records: List[int] = []
2344 used_in_detector: Set[int] = set()
2345 used_in_observable: Set[int] = set()
2346 first_detector_seen = False
2347 meas_before_first_det: Set[int] = set()
2348 r1_single_det_anc: Set[int] = set()
2349 multi_det_groups: List[Set[int]] = []
2350
2351 for inst in flat_circ:
2352 name = inst.name
2353 targets = inst.targets_copy()
2354 if name in ["R", "RX", "RY", "RZ"]:
2355 for t in targets:
2356 if t.is_qubit_target and t.value in tot_resets:
2357 tot_resets[t.value] += 1
2358 elif name in ["M", "MX", "MY", "MZ"]:
2359 for t in targets:
2360 if t.is_qubit_target:
2361 if t.value in tot_meas:
2362 tot_meas[t.value] += 1
2363 meas_records.append(t.value)
2364 if not first_detector_seen:
2365 meas_before_first_det.add(t.value)
2366 elif name in ["MR", "MRX", "MRY", "MRZ"]:
2367 for t in targets:
2368 if t.is_qubit_target:
2369 if t.value in tot_resets:
2370 tot_resets[t.value] += 1
2371 if t.value in tot_meas:
2372 tot_meas[t.value] += 1
2373 meas_records.append(t.value)
2374 if not first_detector_seen:
2375 meas_before_first_det.add(t.value)
2376 elif name == "DETECTOR":
2377 first_detector_seen = True
2378 recs = [
2379 meas_records[len(meas_records) + t.value]
2380 for t in targets
2381 if t.is_measurement_record_target
2382 and 0 <= len(meas_records) + t.value < len(meas_records)
2383 ]
2384 for q in recs:
2385 used_in_detector.add(q)
2386 if len(recs) == 1:
2387 r1_single_det_anc.add(recs[0])
2388 elif len(recs) > 1:
2389 multi_det_groups.append(set(recs))
2390 elif name == "OBSERVABLE_INCLUDE":
2391 for t in targets:
2392 if t.is_measurement_record_target:
2393 idx = len(meas_records) + t.value
2394 if 0 <= idx < len(meas_records):
2395 used_in_observable.add(meas_records[idx])
2396
2397 max_resets = max(tot_resets.values()) if tot_resets else 0
2398 max_meas = max(tot_meas.values()) if tot_meas else 0
2399
2400 data_qubits: Set[int] = set()
2401 anc_candidates: Set[int] = set()
2402
2403 for q in active_qubits:
2404 if max_resets > 1:
2405 is_data = (tot_resets[q] <= 1)
2406 elif max_meas > 1:
2407 is_data = (tot_meas[q] <= 1)
2408 else:
2409 if q not in used_in_detector:
2410 is_data = True
2411 else:
2412 is_data = (
2413 (q not in meas_before_first_det)
2414 or (q in used_in_observable)
2415 )
2416 if is_data:
2417 data_qubits.add(q)
2418 else:
2419 anc_candidates.add(q)
2420
2421 # First-round stabilizer & data-basis tracking
2422 reset_basis: Dict[int, str] = {}
2423 meas_basis: Dict[int, str] = {}
2424 first_round_insts: List[Tuple[str, List[int]]] = []
2425 measured_anc: Set[int] = set()
2426 has_any_anc_meas = False
2427
2428 for inst in flat_circ:
2429 name = inst.name
2430 t_vals = [t.value for t in inst.targets_copy() if t.is_qubit_target]
2431 if name in ["R", "RZ", "RX", "RY"]:
2432 if has_any_anc_meas and any(
2433 q in anc_candidates and q in measured_anc for q in t_vals
2434 ):
2435 break
2436 b = "X" if name == "RX" else ("Y" if name == "RY" else "Z")
2437 for q in t_vals:
2438 if q not in reset_basis:
2439 reset_basis[q] = b
2440 first_round_insts.append((name, t_vals))
2441 elif name in ["M", "MZ", "MX", "MY", "MR", "MRZ", "MRX", "MRY"]:
2442 if any(q in data_qubits for q in t_vals) and has_any_anc_meas:
2443 break
2444 if any(q in anc_candidates and q in measured_anc for q in t_vals):
2445 break
2446 b = (
2447 "X" if name in ["MX", "MRX"]
2448 else ("Y" if name in ["MY", "MRY"] else "Z")
2449 )
2450 for q in t_vals:
2451 if q in anc_candidates:
2452 meas_basis[q] = b
2453 measured_anc.add(q)
2454 has_any_anc_meas = True
2455 if q not in reset_basis and name in [
2456 "MR", "MRZ", "MRX", "MRY"
2457 ]:
2458 reset_basis[q] = b
2459 first_round_insts.append((name, t_vals))
2460 elif name in [
2461 "H", "H_XZ", "H_XY", "H_YZ", "S", "S_DAG",
2462 "SQRT_Z", "SQRT_Z_DAG", "SQRT_X", "SQRT_X_DAG",
2463 "SQRT_Y", "SQRT_Y_DAG",
2464 "CX", "ZCX", "CZ", "ZCZ", "CY", "ZCY",
2465 "XCX", "XCY", "XCZ", "YCX", "YCY", "YCZ"
2466 ]:
2467 first_round_insts.append((name, t_vals))
2468
2469 def conj_1q(gate: str, p: str) -> str:
2470 if p == "I":
2471 return "I"
2472 if gate in ["H", "H_XZ"]:
2473 return "Z" if p == "X" else ("X" if p == "Z" else "Y")
2474 if gate in ["S", "S_DAG", "SQRT_Z", "SQRT_Z_DAG", "H_XY"]:
2475 return "Y" if p == "X" else ("X" if p == "Y" else "Z")
2476 if gate in ["SQRT_X", "SQRT_X_DAG", "H_YZ"]:
2477 return "Z" if p == "Y" else ("Y" if p == "Z" else "X")
2478 if gate in ["SQRT_Y", "SQRT_Y_DAG"]:
2479 return "Z" if p == "X" else ("X" if p == "Z" else "Y")
2480 return p
2481
2482 mul_tab = {
2483 ("I", "I"): "I", ("I", "X"): "X", ("I", "Y"): "Y", ("I", "Z"): "Z",
2484 ("X", "I"): "X", ("X", "X"): "I", ("X", "Y"): "Z", ("X", "Z"): "Y",
2485 ("Y", "I"): "Y", ("Y", "X"): "Z", ("Y", "Y"): "I", ("Y", "Z"): "X",
2486 ("Z", "I"): "Z", ("Z", "X"): "Y", ("Z", "Y"): "X", ("Z", "Z"): "I",
2487 }
2488
2489 def conj_2q(gate: str, p1: str, p2: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
2490 if p1 == "I" and p2 == "I":
2491 return "I", "I"
2492 if gate in ["CX", "ZCX"]:
2493 a, b = "Z", "X"
2494 elif gate in ["CZ", "ZCZ"]:
2495 a, b = "Z", "Z"
2496 elif gate in ["CY", "ZCY"]:
2497 a, b = "Z", "Y"
2498 elif gate == "XCX":
2499 a, b = "X", "X"
2500 elif gate == "XCY":
2501 a, b = "X", "Y"
2502 elif gate == "XCZ":
2503 a, b = "X", "Z"
2504 elif gate == "YCX":
2505 a, b = "Y", "X"
2506 elif gate == "YCY":
2507 a, b = "Y", "Y"
2508 elif gate == "YCZ":
2509 a, b = "Y", "Z"
2510 else:
2511 return p1, p2
2512 anti1 = (p1 != "I" and p1 != a)
2513 anti2 = (p2 != "I" and p2 != b)
2514 np1 = mul_tab[(p1, a)] if anti2 else p1
2515 np2 = mul_tab[(p2, b)] if anti1 else p2
2516 return np1, np2
2517
2518 # Simultaneously evolve all ancilla stabilizers and data initial bases
2519 # using bitmasks over sorted anc_list for O(1) gate updates.
2520 anc_list = sorted(list(anc_candidates))
2521 anc_to_bit = {anc: (1 << i) for i, anc in enumerate(anc_list)}
2522 all_anc_mask = (1 << len(anc_list)) - 1
2523 active_anc_mask = 0
2524 qx: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in all_qubits_set}
2525 qz: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in all_qubits_set}
2526
2527 for anc in anc_list:
2528 b = reset_basis.get(anc, meas_basis.get(anc, "Z"))
2529 bit = anc_to_bit[anc]
2530 if b in ["X", "Y"]:
2531 qx[anc] |= bit
2532 if b in ["Z", "Y"]:
2533 qz[anc] |= bit
2534 if anc not in reset_basis:
2535 active_anc_mask |= bit
2536
2537 data_init_basis: Dict[int, str] = {q: "Z" for q in data_qubits}
2538
2539 for name, t_vals in first_round_insts:
2540 if name in ["R", "RZ", "RX", "RY"]:
2541 b = "X" if name == "RX" else ("Y" if name == "RY" else "Z")
2542 for q in t_vals:
2543 if q in data_qubits:
2544 data_init_basis[q] = b
2545 if q in anc_to_bit:
2546 bit = anc_to_bit[q]
2547 if not (active_anc_mask & bit):
2548 active_anc_mask |= bit
2549 if b in ["X", "Y"]:
2550 qx[q] |= bit
2551 else:
2552 qx[q] &= ~bit
2553 if b in ["Z", "Y"]:
2554 qz[q] |= bit
2555 else:
2556 qz[q] &= ~bit
2557 elif name in ["M", "MZ", "MX", "MY", "MR", "MRZ", "MRX", "MRY"]:
2558 for q in t_vals:
2559 if q in anc_to_bit:
2560 active_anc_mask &= ~anc_to_bit[q]
2561 elif name in [
2562 "H", "H_XZ", "H_XY", "H_YZ", "S", "S_DAG",
2563 "SQRT_Z", "SQRT_Z_DAG", "SQRT_X", "SQRT_X_DAG",
2564 "SQRT_Y", "SQRT_Y_DAG"
2565 ]:
2566 for q in t_vals:
2567 if q in data_qubits:
2568 data_init_basis[q] = conj_1q(name, data_init_basis[q])
2569 if q not in qx:
2570 continue
2571 # on a data qubit, the Paulis of all checks are transformed, also of the checks already measured:
2572 # all checks are then expressed in the same frame (that of the data qubits at the end of the first
2573 # round), e.g., for X checks measured in the Hadamard frame of the data qubits before the closing H
2574 # gates (with active_anc_mask, such checks would look like Z checks; see the tests)
2575 mask = active_anc_mask if q in anc_candidates else all_anc_mask
2576 x_m = qx[q] & mask
2577 z_m = qz[q] & mask
2578 if name in ["H", "H_XZ", "SQRT_Y", "SQRT_Y_DAG"]:
2579 nx_m, nz_m = z_m, x_m
2580 elif name in [
2581 "S", "S_DAG", "SQRT_Z", "SQRT_Z_DAG", "H_XY"
2582 ]:
2583 nx_m, nz_m = x_m, x_m ^ z_m
2584 elif name in ["SQRT_X", "SQRT_X_DAG", "H_YZ"]:
2585 nx_m, nz_m = x_m ^ z_m, z_m
2586 else:
2587 nx_m, nz_m = x_m, z_m
2588 qx[q] = (qx[q] & ~mask) | nx_m
2589 qz[q] = (qz[q] & ~mask) | nz_m
2590 elif name in [
2591 "CX", "ZCX", "CZ", "ZCZ", "CY", "ZCY",
2592 "XCX", "XCY", "XCZ", "YCX", "YCY", "YCZ"
2593 ]:
2594 if name in ["CX", "ZCX"]:
2595 ax, az, bx, bz = 0, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, 0
2596 elif name in ["CZ", "ZCZ"]:
2597 ax, az, bx, bz = 0, all_anc_mask, 0, all_anc_mask
2598 elif name in ["CY", "ZCY"]:
2599 ax, az, bx, bz = 0, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask
2600 elif name == "XCX":
2601 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, 0, all_anc_mask, 0
2602 elif name == "XCY":
2603 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, 0, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask
2604 elif name == "XCZ":
2605 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, 0, 0, all_anc_mask
2606 elif name == "YCX":
2607 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, 0
2608 elif name == "YCY":
2609 ax, az, bx, bz = (
2610 all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask
2611 )
2612 elif name == "YCZ":
2613 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, 0, all_anc_mask
2614 else:
2615 continue
2616
2617 for idx in range(0, len(t_vals), 2):
2618 q1, q2 = t_vals[idx], t_vals[idx + 1]
2619 if q1 not in qx or q2 not in qx:
2620 continue
2621 mask = active_anc_mask
2622 if q1 in anc_to_bit and not (active_anc_mask & anc_to_bit[q1]):
2623 mask &= ~anc_to_bit[q1]
2624 if q2 in anc_to_bit and not (active_anc_mask & anc_to_bit[q2]):
2625 mask &= ~anc_to_bit[q2]
2626 x1 = qx[q1] & mask
2627 z1 = qz[q1] & mask
2628 x2 = qx[q2] & mask
2629 z2 = qz[q2] & mask
2630 anti1 = (x1 & (az & mask)) ^ (z1 & (ax & mask))
2631 anti2 = (x2 & (bz & mask)) ^ (z2 & (bx & mask))
2632 nx1 = x1 ^ (anti2 & ax)
2633 nz1 = z1 ^ (anti2 & az)
2634 nx2 = x2 ^ (anti1 & bx)
2635 nz2 = z2 ^ (anti1 & bz)
2636 qx[q1] = (qx[q1] & ~mask) | nx1
2637 qz[q1] = (qz[q1] & ~mask) | nz1
2638 qx[q2] = (qx[q2] & ~mask) | nx2
2639 qz[q2] = (qz[q2] & ~mask) | nz2
2640
2641 anc_data_paulis: Dict[int, Dict[int, str]] = {
2642 anc: {} for anc in anc_list
2643 }
2644 for q in data_qubits:
2645 xm = qx[q]
2646 zm = qz[q]
2647 active_m = xm | zm
2648 while active_m:
2649 lsb = active_m & -active_m
2650 anc_idx = lsb.bit_length() - 1
2651 anc = anc_list[anc_idx]
2652 has_x = bool(xm & lsb)
2653 has_z = bool(zm & lsb)
2654 p_str = (
2655 "Y" if (has_x and has_z)
2656 else ("X" if has_x else "Z")
2657 )
2658 anc_data_paulis[anc][q] = p_str
2659 active_m ^= lsb
2660
2661 active_ancillas = [a for a in anc_list if len(anc_data_paulis[a]) > 0]
2662 idle_ancillas = [a for a in anc_list if len(anc_data_paulis[a]) == 0]
2663 routing_qubits.update(idle_ancillas)
2664
2665 # Check commutation among active ancillas
2666 checks_commute = True
2667 for i in range(len(active_ancillas)):
2668 a1 = active_ancillas[i]
2669 s1 = anc_data_paulis[a1]
2670 for j in range(i + 1, len(active_ancillas)):
2671 a2 = active_ancillas[j]
2672 s2 = anc_data_paulis[a2]
2673 anti = 0
2674 for q, p1 in s1.items():
2675 p2 = s2.get(q)
2676 if p2 is not None and p1 != p2:
2677 anti ^= 1
2678 if anti != 0:
2679 checks_commute = False
2680 break
2681 if not checks_commute:
2682 break
2683
2684 # Build check-relation graph on active_ancillas via shared data qubits
2685 adj: Dict[int, Dict[int, int]] = {a: {} for a in active_ancillas}
2686 bipartite_paulis = True
2687 for q in data_qubits:
2688 touching = [
2689 (a, anc_data_paulis[a][q])
2690 for a in active_ancillas
2691 if q in anc_data_paulis[a]
2692 ]
2693 if not touching:
2694 continue
2695 pauli_set = {p for _, p in touching}
2696 if len(pauli_set) > 2:
2697 bipartite_paulis = False
2698 break
2699 a0, p0 = touching[0]
2700 for ak, pk in touching[1:]:
2701 rel = 0 if pk == p0 else 1
2702 if ak in adj[a0] and adj[a0][ak] != rel:
2703 bipartite_paulis = False
2704 break
2705 adj[a0][ak] = rel
2706 adj[ak][a0] = rel
2707 if not bipartite_paulis:
2708 break
2709
2710 # 2-color connected components of active_ancillas
2711 color: Dict[int, int] = {}
2712 components: List[Tuple[List[int], List[int]]] = []
2713 if bipartite_paulis:
2714 for a in active_ancillas:
2715 if a in color:
2716 continue
2717 c0: List[int] = []
2718 c1: List[int] = []
2719 color[a] = 0
2720 queue = [a]
2721 idx_q = 0
2722 while idx_q < len(queue):
2723 u = queue[idx_q]
2724 idx_q += 1
2725 if color[u] == 0:
2726 c0.append(u)
2727 else:
2728 c1.append(u)
2729 for v, rel in adj[u].items():
2730 expected = color[u] ^ rel
2731 if v not in color:
2732 color[v] = expected
2733 queue.append(v)
2734 elif color[v] != expected:
2735 bipartite_paulis = False
2736 break
2737 if not bipartite_paulis:
2738 break
2739 if not bipartite_paulis:
2740 break
2741 components.append((c0, c1))
2742
2743 # Determine if all checks are already pure-X or pure-Z (standard CSS)
2744 all_pure_xz = True
2745 for a in active_ancillas:
2746 ps = set(anc_data_paulis[a].values())
2747 if not (ps == {"X"} or ps == {"Z"}):
2748 all_pure_xz = False
2749 break
2750
2751 # Detect color code (pure X and pure Z checks with identical support)
2752 native_basis = detect_basis(
2753 circuit, filepath=filepath, basis_arg=basis_arg
2754 )
2755 final_det_anc: Set[int] = set()
2756 for grp in multi_det_groups:
2757 if grp & data_qubits:
2758 final_det_anc.update(grp & set(active_ancillas))
2759
2760 x_ancillas: Set[int] = set()
2761 z_ancillas: Set[int] = set()
2762 rotated_data_qubits: Set[int] = set()
2763 is_css = False
2764 is_rotated_css = False
2765
2766 if checks_commute and bipartite_paulis and active_ancillas:
2767 if all_pure_xz:
2768 for a in active_ancillas:
2769 ps = set(anc_data_paulis[a].values())
2770 if ps == {"X"}:
2771 x_ancillas.add(a)
2772 else:
2773 z_ancillas.add(a)
2774 x_supps = {
2775 frozenset(anc_data_paulis[a].keys()) for a in x_ancillas
2776 }
2777 z_supps = {
2778 frozenset(anc_data_paulis[a].keys()) for a in z_ancillas
2779 }
2780 is_color_code = (
2781 len(x_supps) > 0 and x_supps == z_supps
2782 and len(x_ancillas) == len(z_ancillas)
2783 )
2784 is_css = not is_color_code
2785 is_rotated_css = False
2786 else:
2787 is_css = True
2788 is_rotated_css = True
2789 for c0, c1 in components:
2790 # Score which sector is the primary memory basis
2791 def score_primary(sector: List[int]) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
2792 r1_cnt = sum(1 for a in sector if a in r1_single_det_anc)
2793 fin_cnt = sum(1 for a in sector if a in final_det_anc)
2794 init_cnt = sum(
2795 1 for a in sector
2796 if all(
2797 anc_data_paulis[a][q] == data_init_basis.get(q, "Z")
2798 for q in anc_data_paulis[a]
2799 )
2800 )
2801 return (r1_cnt, fin_cnt, init_cnt)
2802
2803 sc0 = score_primary(c0)
2804 sc1 = score_primary(c1)
2805 if sc0 >= sc1:
2806 primary_sec, minority_sec = c0, c1
2807 else:
2808 primary_sec, minority_sec = c1, c0
2809
2810 if native_basis == "Z":
2811 z_ancillas.update(primary_sec)
2812 x_ancillas.update(minority_sec)
2813 else:
2814 x_ancillas.update(primary_sec)
2815 z_ancillas.update(minority_sec)
2816
2817 # Determine rotated data qubits (where check Pauli != sector label)
2818 for q in data_qubits:
2819 for a in active_ancillas:
2820 if q in anc_data_paulis[a]:
2821 sector_label = "X" if a in x_ancillas else "Z"
2822 if anc_data_paulis[a][q] != sector_label:
2823 rotated_data_qubits.add(q)
2824 break
2825 else:
2826 # Non-CSS fallback classification by majority Pauli weight
2827 is_css = False
2828 is_rotated_css = False
2829 for a in active_ancillas:
2830 s = anc_data_paulis[a]
2831 nx = sum(1 for p in s.values() if p == "X")
2832 nz = sum(1 for p in s.values() if p == "Z")
2833 if nz > nx:
2834 z_ancillas.add(a)
2835 else:
2836 x_ancillas.add(a)
2837
2838 return {
2839 "x_ancillas": sorted(list(x_ancillas)),
2840 "z_ancillas": sorted(list(z_ancillas)),
2841 "data_qubits": sorted(list(data_qubits)),
2842 "routing_qubits": sorted(list(routing_qubits)),
2843 "rotated_data_qubits": sorted(list(rotated_data_qubits)),
2844 "is_css": is_css,
2845 "is_rotated_css": is_rotated_css,
2846 "basis": native_basis,
2847 "rewritten_circuit": rewritten_circ,
2848 }
2849
2850
2851def verify_qubit_metadata(
2852 circuit: Any,
2853 verbose: bool = False,
2854 basis_arg: Optional[str] = None,
2855 filepath: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
2856) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2857 """Verifies qubit classification and returns basis tracking metadata."""
2858 return classify_qubits_thorough(
2859 circuit, verbose=verbose, basis_arg=basis_arg, filepath=filepath
2860 )
2861
2862
2863def strip_minority_detectors(
2864 circuit: Any,
2865 basis: str,
2866 verbose: bool = False,
2867 thorough: bool = True,
2868 thorough_res: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
2869 mask_out: Optional[List[bool]] = None
2870) -> Tuple[Any, int, int]:
2871 """Strips detectors corresponding to the minority basis from a Stim circuit.
2872
2873 Always uses ancilla and data basis tracking (and dynamic carrier tracking
2874 across SWAPs and syndrome handoffs) to identify each detector's basis.
2875
2876 Args:
2877 circuit: A stim.Circuit object or path to a .stim file.
2878 basis: Primary memory basis ('X' or 'Z'). Detectors of the opposite
2879 basis are removed.
2880 verbose: Whether to print warnings/statistics.
2881 thorough: Kept for API compatibility (basis tracking is always enabled).
2882 thorough_res: Optional precomputed result from classify_qubits_thorough.
2883 mask_out: Optional list, extended by one entry per detector of the circuit (in the order of the detectors of
2884 its DEM, REPEAT blocks unrolled): True if the detector is stripped, False if it is kept.
2885
2886 Returns:
2887 Tuple of (simplified_circuit, stripped_count, kept_count).
2888 """
2889 stim = _get_stim()
2890 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
2891 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
2892
2893 t_res = (
2894 thorough_res
2895 if thorough_res is not None
2896 else classify_qubits_thorough(circuit, verbose=False, basis_arg=basis)
2897 )
2898 x_anc = set(t_res["x_ancillas"])
2899 z_anc = set(t_res["z_ancillas"])
2900 minority_basis = "Z" if basis.upper() == "X" else "X"
2901
2902 meas_carriers = track_circuit_carriers(circuit)
2903
2904 # Coordinate metadata for consistency check on standard (non-rotated) CSS
2905 qubit_coords: Dict[int, Tuple[float, ...]] = {}
2906
2907 def get_coords(blk: Any) -> None:
2908 for inst in blk:
2909 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
2910 get_coords(inst.body_copy())
2911 elif inst.name == "QUBIT_COORDS":
2912 args = inst.gate_args_copy()
2913 for t in inst.targets_copy():
2914 if t.is_qubit_target:
2915 qubit_coords[t.value] = tuple(float(x) for x in args)
2916
2917 get_coords(circuit)
2918 x_coords = {
2919 qubit_coords[q][:2]
2920 for q in x_anc
2921 if q in qubit_coords and len(qubit_coords[q]) >= 2
2922 }
2923 z_coords = {
2924 qubit_coords[q][:2]
2925 for q in z_anc
2926 if q in qubit_coords and len(qubit_coords[q]) >= 2
2927 }
2928 layout_well_defined = (
2929 not t_res.get("is_rotated_css", False)
2930 and len(x_coords) > 0
2931 and len(z_coords) > 0
2932 and x_coords.isdisjoint(z_coords)
2933 )
2934
2935 meas_history: List[int] = []
2936 det_mask: List[bool] = [] # one entry per detector (REPEAT blocks unrolled): True if stripped
2937 stripped_count = 0
2938 kept_count = 0
2939 contradictions_c_count = 0
2940 floquet_suspected = False
2941
2942 def process_block(block: Any) -> Any:
2943 nonlocal stripped_count, kept_count
2944 nonlocal contradictions_c_count, floquet_suspected
2945 new_block = stim.Circuit()
2946 for inst in block:
2947 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
2948 rep_count = inst.repeat_count
2949 if rep_count <= 0:
2950 continue
2951 body_copy = inst.body_copy()
2952 meas_before = len(meas_history)
2953 mask_before = len(det_mask)
2954 strip_before = stripped_count
2955 kept_before = kept_count
2956 new_body = process_block(body_copy)
2957 meas_after = len(meas_history)
2958 meas_per_rep = meas_after - meas_before
2959 if rep_count > 1:
2960 stripped_count += (stripped_count - strip_before) * (
2961 rep_count - 1
2962 )
2963 kept_count += (kept_count - kept_before) * (rep_count - 1)
2964 det_mask.extend(det_mask[mask_before:] * (rep_count - 1))
2965 if meas_per_rep > 0:
2966 meas_history.extend(
2967 meas_history[meas_before:meas_after]
2968 * (rep_count - 1)
2969 )
2970 new_block.append(stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(rep_count, new_body))
2971 elif inst.name in [
2972 "M", "MX", "MY", "MZ", "MR", "MRX", "MRY", "MRZ"
2973 ]:
2974 if inst.name in ["MY", "MRY"]:
2975 floquet_suspected = True
2976 for t in inst.targets_copy():
2977 if t.is_qubit_target:
2978 meas_history.append(t.value)
2979 new_block.append(inst)
2980 elif inst.name == "DETECTOR":
2981 cur_meas = len(meas_history)
2982 rec_targets = [
2983 t for t in inst.targets_copy()
2984 if t.is_measurement_record_target
2985 ]
2986 if not rec_targets:
2987 stripped_count += 1
2988 det_mask.append(True)
2989 continue
2990
2991 qubits = [
2992 meas_history[cur_meas + t.value]
2993 for t in rec_targets
2994 if 0 <= cur_meas + t.value < cur_meas
2995 ]
2996 is_x_qubit = any(q in x_anc for q in qubits)
2997 is_z_qubit = any(q in z_anc for q in qubits)
2998 class_qubit = (
2999 "Both" if (is_x_qubit and is_z_qubit)
3000 else "X" if is_x_qubit
3001 else "Z" if is_z_qubit
3002 else "Unknown"
3003 )
3004
3005 args = inst.gate_args_copy()
3006 class_b = "Unknown"
3007 if layout_well_defined and args and len(args) >= 2:
3008 det_xy = (float(args[0]), float(args[1]))
3009 if det_xy in x_coords:
3010 class_b = "X"
3011 elif det_xy in z_coords:
3012 class_b = "Z"
3013
3014 class_c = "Unknown"
3015 if meas_carriers:
3016 carriers = [
3017 c
3018 for t in rec_targets
3019 if 0 <= cur_meas + t.value < len(meas_carriers)
3020 for c in meas_carriers[cur_meas + t.value]
3021 ]
3022 is_x_c = any(c in x_anc for c in carriers)
3023 is_z_c = any(c in z_anc for c in carriers)
3024 class_c = (
3025 "Both" if (is_x_c and is_z_c)
3026 else "X" if is_x_c
3027 else "Z" if is_z_c
3028 else "Unknown"
3029 )
3030
3031 is_minority = False
3032 if class_c != "Unknown":
3033 if class_c == "Both":
3034 contradictions_c_count += 1
3035 floquet_suspected = True
3036 elif class_b != "Unknown" and class_c != class_b:
3037 contradictions_c_count += 1
3038 elif len(rec_targets) == 1 and class_c == minority_basis:
3039 contradictions_c_count += 1
3040 is_minority = (class_c == minority_basis)
3041 elif layout_well_defined and class_b != "Unknown":
3042 is_minority = (class_b == minority_basis)
3043 elif len(rec_targets) == 1:
3044 is_minority = False
3045 else:
3046 if class_qubit == "Both":
3047 floquet_suspected = True
3048 is_minority = (class_qubit == minority_basis)
3049
3050 if is_minority:
3051 stripped_count += 1
3052 else:
3053 kept_count += 1
3054 new_block.append(inst)
3055 det_mask.append(is_minority)
3056 else:
3057 new_block.append(inst)
3058 return new_block
3059
3060 simp_circuit = process_block(circuit)
3061 if mask_out is not None:
3062 mask_out.extend(det_mask)
3063
3064 if contradictions_c_count > 0 and verbose:
3065 sys.stderr.write(
3066 f"# Warning: {contradictions_c_count} detector contradiction(s) "
3067 "detected during dynamic carrier tracking.\n"
3068 )
3069 if floquet_suspected and verbose:
3070 sys.stderr.write(
3071 "# Warning: Floquet or dynamic measurement structure suspected; "
3072 "simplified circuit distance may be invalid.\n"
3073 )
3074
3075 return simp_circuit, stripped_count, kept_count
3076
3077
3078def _matrix_cache_key(H: Any, G: Optional[Any] = None, L: Optional[Any] = None, classical: bool = False) -> str:
3079 """
3080 Cache key of a classical code (H), or of a quantum code given by H with G (or with L). The two sectors of a CSS
3081 code are stored as the quantum codes (H=Hx, G=Hz) -> dZ and (H=Hz, G=Hx) -> dX (with L=Lx / L=Lz if given), so
3082 that compute_css_distance() and compute_quantum_distance() share their cache records.
3083 """
3084 h_state = get_sparse_array_state(H)
3085 if classical:
3086 return f"classical:{h_state}"
3087 if G is not None:
3088 return f"quantum:H={h_state}:G={get_sparse_array_state(G)}"
3089 return f"quantum:H={h_state}:L={get_sparse_array_state(L)}"
3090
3091
3092def _dem_cache_key(dem: Any, pmin: float = 0.0) -> str:
3093 """Cache key of a DEM (a stim.DetectorErrorModel or a .dem file) with the probability cutoff pmin."""
3094 dem_state = get_sparse_array_state(dem)
3095 return f"dem:{dem_state}" if pmin <= 0.0 else f"dem:{dem_state}:pmin={pmin}"
3096

3098def _write_dem_file(dem: Any, path: str) -> None:
3099 """Writes a stim.DetectorErrorModel (flattened) or the text of a DEM to the file `path`."""
3100 if hasattr(dem, 'flattened'):
3101 dem.flattened().to_file(path)
3102 elif hasattr(dem, 'to_file'):
3103 dem.to_file(path)
3104 else:
3105 with open(path, 'w') as f:
3106 f.write(str(dem))
3107
3108
3109def _dem_error_columns(dem: Any, pmin: float = 0.0, with_prob: bool = False) -> List[Tuple[Any, ...]]:
3110 """
3111 The columns of a DEM (a stim.DetectorErrorModel, or a .dem file) as read by the dist_m4ri binary: the detector and
3112 observable sets of its error mechanisms, in their order in the flattened DEM (repeat blocks unrolled, with
3113 shift_detectors), after the probability cutoff pmin (an error with probability < pmin is skipped). The components
3114 of a decomposed error (separated by '^') are summed mod 2, so that a target listed twice cancels. With
3115 with_prob=True, each column also has the probability of the error, as written: (detectors, observables, p).
3116 """
3117 if isinstance(dem, (str, Path)):
3118 with open(str(dem)) as f:
3119 lines = f.read().splitlines()
3120 else:
3121 lines = str(dem.flattened() if hasattr(dem, 'flattened') else dem).splitlines()
3122 cols: List[Tuple[Any, ...]] = []
3123
3124 def block(i: int, shift: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
3125 # runs the instructions from line i up to the closing brace (or the end): (next line, detector shift)
3126 while i < len(lines):
3127 s = lines[i].split('#', 1)[0].strip()
3128 i += 1
3129 if not s:
3130 continue
3131 if s.startswith('}'):
3132 return i, shift
3133 if s.startswith('repeat'):
3134 count = int(s.split()[1])
3135 body, end = i, i
3136 for _ in range(count):
3137 end, shift = block(body, shift)
3138 if count <= 0: # skip the body
3139 depth = 1
3140 while end < len(lines) and depth > 0:
3141 t = lines[end].split('#', 1)[0].strip()
3142 end += 1
3143 depth += t.startswith('repeat') - t.startswith('}')
3144 i = end
3145 elif s.startswith('shift_detectors'):
3146 shift += int(s.rsplit(None, 1)[-1])
3147 elif s.startswith('error'):
3148 p_text = s[s.index('(') + 1:s.index(')')].strip()
3149 if float(p_text) < pmin:
3150 continue
3151 dets: Set[int] = set()
3152 obs: Set[int] = set()
3153 for tok in s[s.index(')') + 1:].split():
3154 if tok[0] == 'D':
3155 dets ^= {int(tok[1:]) + shift}
3156 elif tok[0] == 'L':
3157 obs ^= {int(tok[1:])}
3158 col = (frozenset(dets), frozenset(obs))
3159 cols.append(col + (p_text,) if with_prob else col)
3160 return i, shift
3161
3162 block(0, 0)
3163 return cols
3164
3165
3166def _drop_mode(drop: Any) -> str:
3167 """
3168 The drop option of compute_dem_distance(): "auto" (for None, True, 1, "1", or "auto"), "0" (False, 0, or "0"),
3169 "css", or the name of an existing file (ValueError otherwise).
3170 """
3171 if drop is None or drop is True:
3172 return "auto"
3173 if drop is False:
3174 return "0"
3175 if isinstance(drop, numbers.Integral):
3176 if drop in (0, 1):
3177 return "auto" if drop == 1 else "0"
3178 raise ValueError(f"invalid drop={drop}: use 0, 1, 'auto', 'css', or a file with the detectors to drop")
3179 s = str(drop).strip()
3180 if s.lower() in ("1", "auto"):
3181 return "auto"
3182 if s == "0":
3183 return "0"
3184 if s.lower() == "css":
3185 return "css"
3186 if not os.path.isfile(s):
3187 raise ValueError(f"drop={s}: no such file (use 0, 1, auto, css, or a file with the detectors to drop)")
3188 return s
3189
3190
3191def _reduced_out_prefix(spec: Union[bool, str, Path], src: str, out_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None) -> str:
3192 """
3193 The prefix PREFIX of the files PREFIX_red.dem and PREFIX_red.json of compute_dem_distance(out_reduced=spec) for the
3194 input src (a file name, or e.g. 'stim.Circuit'): for True (also '', '1', 'true', 'yes', 'auto'), the basename of
3195 the input file (without a suffix _full or _simp; 'dem' for an object); a bare name goes to out_dir (default: the
3196 directory of the input file, as for --out-dem), and a path is used as given.
3197 """
3198 src_path = Path(src) if os.path.exists(src) else None
3199 eff_dir = Path(out_dir) if out_dir is not None else (src_path.parent if src_path is not None else Path("."))
3200 if spec is True or (isinstance(spec, str) and spec.strip().lower() in ("", "1", "true", "yes", "auto")):
3201 stem = src_path.stem if src_path is not None else "dem"
3202 if stem.endswith(("_full", "_simp")):
3203 stem = stem[:-5]
3204 return str(eff_dir / stem)
3205 spec_s = str(spec)
3206 return str(eff_dir / spec_s) if (not os.path.isabs(spec_s) and os.path.dirname(spec_s) == "") else spec_s
3207
3208
3209def read_drop_file(path: Union[str, Path]) -> Tuple[List[int], Optional[int]]:
3210 """
3211 Reads a drop file: the 0-based detector indices (k for Dk) separated by white space or commas, where lines starting
3212 with '#' or '%' are comments, e.g., the detectors dropped from a DEM written by the binary (outD=FILE).
3213
3214 Returns:
3215 (detectors, num_detectors): the sorted distinct detectors, and the number of detectors of the DEM from the
3216 comment line '# N of M detectors dropped ...' written by the binary (None if there is none).
3217 """
3218 import re
3219 dets: Set[int] = set()
3220 num: Optional[int] = None
3221 with open(str(path)) as f:
3222 for line in f:
3223 s = line.strip()
3224 if s.startswith('#') or s.startswith('%'):
3225 mm = re.match(r"#\s*\d+ of (\d+) detectors dropped", s)
3226 if mm and num is None:
3227 num = int(mm.group(1))
3228 continue
3229 dets.update(int(tok) for tok in s.replace(',', ' ').split())
3230 return sorted(dets), num
3231
3232
3233def write_reduced_dem(
3234 dem: Any,
3235 dropped: Sequence[int],
3236 prefix: Union[str, Path],
3237 pmin: float = 0.0,
3238 num_detectors: Optional[int] = None,
3239 meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
3240) -> Tuple[str, str]:
3241 """
3242 Writes the DEM (a stim.DetectorErrorModel or a .dem file) without the detectors `dropped` (0-based, e.g., those
3243 dropped by the binary, see compute_dem_distance(outD=..., out_reduced=...)) to PREFIX_red.dem: the errors which
3244 touch none of them (after the cutoff pmin, in the order of the flattened DEM; a decomposed error as the sum of its
3245 components), with the other detectors numbered consecutively, and the observables unchanged. The maps go to
3246 PREFIX_red.json: "detectors" (the original index of each detector of the reduced DEM, i.e., the complement of
3247 "dropped"), "errors" (the original index of each error of the reduced DEM, 0-based in the order of the flattened DEM
3248 after the cutoff pmin, as the columns of the codewords in outC), "dropped", "num_detectors", "num_errors", "pmin",
3249 and the entries of meta. If dropping the detectors is exact (as verified by the binary), the reduced DEM has the
3250 same distance, and its codewords map to codewords of the DEM with "errors".
3251
3252 Returns:
3253 (dem_path, json_path): the files written.
3254 """
3255 cols = _dem_error_columns(dem, pmin, with_prob=True)
3256 drop_set = set(int(r) for r in dropped)
3257 m = 1 + max([d for S, _, _ in cols for d in S] + list(drop_set), default=-1)
3258 if num_detectors is not None:
3259 m = max(m, int(num_detectors))
3260 k = 1 + max((o for _, O, _ in cols for o in O), default=-1)
3261 kept = [r for r in range(m) if r not in drop_set]
3262 new_index = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(kept)}
3263 dem_path, json_path = f"{prefix}_red.dem", f"{prefix}_red.json"
3264 errors: List[int] = []
3265 lines = [f"# reduced DEM: {len(drop_set)} of {m} detectors dropped (dist_m4ri.py {__version__}); the maps to the "
3266 f"original DEM are in {os.path.basename(json_path)}"]
3267 max_det = max_obs = -1
3268 for j, (S, O, p) in enumerate(cols):
3269 if S & drop_set:
3270 continue
3271 dets = sorted(new_index[d] for d in S)
3272 obs = sorted(O)
3273 if dets:
3274 max_det = max(max_det, dets[-1])
3275 if obs:
3276 max_obs = max(max_obs, obs[-1])
3277 lines.append(f"error({p})" + "".join(f" D{d}" for d in dets) + "".join(f" L{o}" for o in obs))
3278 errors.append(j)
3279 if max_det < len(kept) - 1: # (keeps the number of detectors and observables)
3280 lines.append(f"detector D{len(kept) - 1}")
3281 if max_obs < k - 1:
3282 lines.append(f"logical_observable L{k - 1}")
3283 parent_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(dem_path))
3284 os.makedirs(parent_dir, exist_ok=True)
3285 with open(dem_path, "w") as f:
3286 f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
3287 info: Dict[str, Any] = {"__version__": __version__}
3288 info.update(meta or {})
3289 info.update({"pmin": pmin, "num_detectors": m, "num_errors": len(cols), "dropped": sorted(drop_set),
3290 "detectors": kept, "errors": errors})
3291 with open(json_path, "w") as f:
3292 json.dump(info, f, separators=(",", ":"))
3293 f.write("\n")
3294 return dem_path, json_path
3295
3296
3297def _expand_equal_columns(
3298 cws: List[List[int]],
3299 dem: Any,
3300 pmin: float = 0.0,
3301 maxC: int = 0,
3302 verbose: bool = False
3303) -> List[List[int]]:
3304 """
3305 The expanded list of the DEM codewords cws (0-based columns of the DEM, see _dem_error_columns()): every version
3306 over the choices among equal columns (the same detectors and observables), which the binary merges (merge=1).
3307 Each codeword is mapped to the first columns of its sets of equal columns (two equal columns cancel), and every
3308 distinct result c is expanded into the prod_{j in c} |set(j)| codewords with one column from each set (sorted, in
3309 the order of cws). With maxC > 0, at most maxC codewords are returned, with a warning to stderr if some are
3310 dropped.
3311 """
3312 if not cws:
3313 return []
3314 cols = _dem_error_columns(dem, pmin)
3315 sets: Dict[Tuple[frozenset, frozenset], List[int]] = {}
3316 for j, c in enumerate(cols):
3317 sets.setdefault(c, []).append(j)
3318 members = [sets[c] for c in cols] # the sorted set of the columns equal to column j (j included)
3319 keys: List[Tuple[int, ...]] = []
3320 seen: Set[Tuple[int, ...]] = set()
3321 for cw in cws:
3322 if any(j < 0 or j >= len(members) for j in cw):
3323 raise ValueError(f"expand: codeword column out of range (the DEM has {len(members)} columns after the "
3324 f"pmin={pmin} cutoff)")
3325 odd: Set[int] = set()
3326 for j in cw:
3327 odd ^= {members[j][0]}
3328 key = tuple(sorted(odd))
3329 if key and key not in seen:
3330 seen.add(key)
3331 keys.append(key)
3332 total = 0
3333 for key in keys:
3334 num = 1
3335 for r in key:
3336 num *= len(members[r])
3337 total += num
3338 limit = total if maxC <= 0 else min(total, maxC)
3339 out: List[List[int]] = []
3340 for key in keys:
3341 if len(out) >= limit:
3342 break
3343 for choice in itertools.product(*(members[r] for r in key)):
3344 out.append(sorted(choice))
3345 if len(out) >= limit:
3346 break
3347 if limit < total:
3348 sys.stderr.write(f"# Warning: expand: the expanded list has {total} codewords ({len(keys)} up to equal "
3349 f"columns); only the first maxC={maxC} are written (the list is incomplete)\n")
3350 elif verbose:
3351 print(f"[dist_m4ri] expand: {len(keys)} codewords up to equal columns -> {total} codewords")
3352 return out
3353
3354
3355def _css_sector_codes(Hx: Any, Hz: Any, Lx: Optional[Any], Lz: Optional[Any]) -> Dict[str, Tuple[Any, Any, Any]]:
3356 """The quantum codes (H, G, L) of the two sectors of a CSS code: Z -> (Hx, Hz or Lx), X -> (Hz, Hx or Lz)."""
3357 return {
3358 "Z": (Hx, Hz if Lx is None else None, Lx),
3359 "X": (Hz, Hx if Lz is None else None, Lz),
3360 }
3361
3362
3363def _css_combine(
3364 x: Tuple[int, int, int], z: Tuple[int, int, int], dmax: int = 0
3365) -> Tuple[int, int, int, int]:
3366 """
3367 Bounds of the CSS distance d = min(dX, dZ) from the sector bounds x, z = (dmin, dmax, rw_steps), and an upper
3368 bound `dmax` on d supplied by the user (0: none).
3369
3370 Returns:
3371 (dist, dmin, dmax, rw_steps): dist is the smaller sector distance (see _dist_from_bounds(); the larger one if
3372 a sector distance is 0), at most the user's dmax; dmin = min(dmin_X, dmin_Z); dmax is the smallest of the
3373 positive upper bounds (0: none).
3374 """
3375 d_lo = min(x[0], z[0])
3376 uppers = [v for v in (x[1], z[1], dmax) if v > 0]
3377 d_hi = min(uppers) if uppers else 0
3378 if d_hi > 0 and d_lo > d_hi:
3379 d_lo = d_hi
3380 dist_x, dist_z = _dist_from_bounds(x[0], x[1]), _dist_from_bounds(z[0], z[1])
3381 dist = min(dist_x, dist_z) if (dist_x > 0 and dist_z > 0) else max(dist_x, dist_z)
3382 if dmax > 0 and dist > dmax:
3383 dist = dmax
3384 if d_lo > 0 and d_lo == d_hi:
3385 dist = d_lo
3386 return dist, d_lo, d_hi, x[2] + z[2]
3387
3388
3389def _sector_record(dmin: int, dmax: int, rw_steps: int, cws: List[List[int]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3390 """A cache record of a classical or quantum code (or of a CSS sector) with the bounds [dmin, dmax]."""
3391 if dmax > 0 and dmin > dmax:
3392 dmin = dmax
3393 return {
3394 "dist": _dist_from_bounds(dmin, dmax),
3395 "dmin": dmin,
3396 "dmax": dmax,
3397 "rw_steps": rw_steps,
3398 "d_info": format_bounds_list(dmin, dmax, rw_steps),
3399 "cws": cws,
3400 }
3401
3402
3403def _migrate_css_records(
3404 Hx: Any, Hz: Any, Lx: Optional[Any] = None, Lz: Optional[Any] = None, eff_cache_file: Optional[str] = None
3405) -> bool:
3406 """
3407 Converts the CSS cache records written before version 0.12.0 (key 'css:X=<Hx>:Z=<Hz>[:Lx=<Lx>:Lz=<Lz>]', also
3408 with a ':start=...' suffix) into the records of the two sectors (see _matrix_cache_key()), and removes them.
3409
3410 The lower bounds dmin_X and dmin_Z are kept. An upper bound dmax_X or dmax_Z is kept only if a stored codeword
3411 confirms it, or if it is smaller than the upper bound of the other sector: earlier versions passed an upper bound
3412 dmax given to compute_css_distance() (a bound on min(dX, dZ)) to both sectors, where it was reported back as the
3413 upper bound of the sector, which is not valid for the sector with the larger distance. Otherwise, the weight of
3414 the lightest stored codeword (if any) is used.
3415
3416 Returns:
3417 True if a record was converted (the cache file, if any, is then saved).
3418 """
3419 global _distance_cache
3420 old = f"css:X={get_sparse_array_state(Hx)}:Z={get_sparse_array_state(Hz)}"
3421 if Lx is not None or Lz is not None:
3422 old = f"{old}:Lx={get_sparse_array_state(Lx)}:Lz={get_sparse_array_state(Lz)}"
3423 old_keys = [k for k in list(_distance_cache) if k == old or k.startswith(old + ":start=")]
3424 if not old_keys:
3425 return False
3426 codes = _css_sector_codes(Hx, Hz, Lx, Lz)
3427 base = {s: _matrix_cache_key(*codes[s]) for s in ("X", "Z")}
3428 for key in old_keys:
3429 rec = _distance_cache.pop(key)
3430 if not isinstance(rec, dict):
3431 continue
3432 sfx = key[len(old):]
3433 for s, other in (("X", "Z"), ("Z", "X")):
3434 dmin = int(rec.get(f"dmin_{s}", rec.get("dmin", 0)) or 0)
3435 dmax = int(rec.get(f"dmax_{s}", 0) or 0)
3436 other_dmax = int(rec.get(f"dmax_{other}", 0) or 0)
3437 cws = [list(cw) for cw in (rec.get(f"cws_{s}") or [])]
3438 w_cw = min((len(cw) for cw in cws), default=0)
3439 if dmax > 0 and w_cw != dmax and not (dmax < other_dmax):
3440 dmax = 0 # possibly the upper bound on min(dX, dZ) reported back by the binary
3441 if w_cw > 0:
3442 dmax = min(dmax, w_cw) if dmax > 0 else w_cw
3443 rw = int(rec.get(f"rw_steps_{s}", 0) or 0)
3444 skey = base[s] + sfx
3445 prev = _distance_cache.get(skey)
3446 if prev:
3447 p_dmax = prev.get("dmax", 0) or 0
3448 dmax = min(p_dmax, dmax) if (p_dmax > 0 and dmax > 0) else max(p_dmax, dmax)
3449 dmin = max(prev.get("dmin", 0) or 0, dmin)
3450 rw = max(prev.get("rw_steps", 0) or 0, rw)
3451 cws = _union_cws(prev.get("cws", []), cws)
3452 _distance_cache[skey] = _sector_record(dmin, dmax, rw, cws)
3453 if eff_cache_file:
3454 save_distance_cache(eff_cache_file)
3455 return True
3456
3457
3458def _cached_code_distance(
3459 H: Any,
3460 G: Optional[Any],
3461 L: Optional[Any],
3462 classical: bool,
3463 kind: str,
3464 dist_m4ri: Optional[str],
3465 method: int,
3466 threads: Optional[int],
3467 timeout: float,
3468 num_steps: Optional[int],
3469 d_exp: int,
3470 dmin: int,
3471 dmax: int,
3472 dstop: int,
3473 wmin: int,
3474 wmax: int,
3475 smax: Optional[int],
3476 start_list: Optional[List[int]],
3477 dW: int,
3478 maxC: int,
3479 finC: Optional[str],
3480 outC: Optional[str],
3481 need_cws: bool,
3482 eff_cache_file: Optional[str],
3483 seed: int,
3484 debug: int,
3485 verbose: bool,
3486 nothrottle: bool,
3487 chunk_size: int,
3488 ksub: int,
3489 kwin: int,
3490 win_mode: int,
3491 min_hits: Optional[int],
3492 cov_cws: int,
3493 refresh: int,
3494 trust_start: bool,
3495 fdem: Optional[Any] = None,
3496 pmin: float = 0.0,
3497 merge: bool = True,
3498 key_fn: Optional[Callable[[], str]] = None,
3499 cws_out_fn: Optional[Callable[[List[List[int]]], List[List[int]]]] = None,
3500 fdrop: Optional[Union[str, Path, List[int]]] = None,
3501 outD: Optional[str] = None,
3502 sort_rows: Optional[bool] = None,
3503 win_hyb: int = 0,
3504 pairs: int = -1
3505) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3506 """
3507 Distance of a classical code (H), of a quantum code (H with G or L), or of a DEM (fdem: a stim DEM object or a .dem
3508 file, with the probability cutoff pmin, merge, the detectors to drop fdrop ("auto", "0", a file, or a list), and
3509 the file outD for the detectors dropped: see run_dist_m4ri()) with the dist_m4ri binary, using the distance cache
3510 shared by compute_classical_distance(), compute_quantum_distance(), the two sectors of compute_css_distance(), and
3511 compute_dem_distance() (the warnings for the expert options are issued by the callers). The row order sort_rows
3512 (see run_dist_m4ri()) does not change the result, nor the cache key; nor do the RW window size win_hyb and the RW
3513 pairs (pairs) change the cache key.
3514
3515 A cache record (key: key_fn() if given, otherwise see _matrix_cache_key()) answers the request if it holds the
3516 exact distance, or with the stop target dstop > 0 a lower bound dmin >= dstop (and the codewords, if needed).
3517 Otherwise, the binary is run, starting from the cached bounds, and the merged bounds are stored. The returned
3518 codewords (those of the run merged with the cached ones, or the cached ones) are written to outC; with finC
3519 identical to outC, the codewords already in the file are kept. If given, cws_out_fn transforms the codewords
3520 returned and written to outC (e.g., the expansion over equal DEM columns, see _expand_equal_columns()); the cache
3521 keeps the codewords as found.
3522
3523 Returns:
3524 dict with the distance "dist" (see _dist_from_bounds()), the bounds "dmin", "dmax", "rw_steps", "d_info"
3525 (see format_bounds_list()), the codewords "cws" (empty unless need_cws), and "cached" (True if no binary run).
3526 """
3527 global _distance_cache, _last_run_stats
3528 _last_run_stats = {} # the statistics of the binary run (none if the result is cached)
3529 same_file = bool(finC and outC) and os.path.abspath(str(finC)) == os.path.abspath(str(outC))
3530 finC = check_finc_outc(finC, outC, verbose=verbose)
3531
3532 def write_out(cws_res: List[List[int]]) -> List[List[int]]:
3533 # the codewords returned (transformed by cws_out_fn) and written to outC; with finC identical to outC, the
3534 # codewords already in the file are kept
3535 if cws_out_fn is not None and cws_res:
3536 cws_res = cws_out_fn(cws_res)
3537 if outC and cws_res:
3538 out = cws_res
3539 if same_file and os.path.isfile(outC):
3540 out = _union_cws(read_sparse_vectors(outC), cws_res)
3541 _write_nzlist_file(outC, out)
3542 return cws_res
3543
3544 code_key = cached_entry = plain_key = plain_entry = None
3545 hit: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None # the result of a cache hit
3546 eff_dmin, eff_dmax = dmin, dmax
3547 if _use_distance_cache:
3548 if eff_cache_file:
3549 load_distance_cache(eff_cache_file)
3550 try:
3551 plain_key = key_fn() if key_fn is not None else _matrix_cache_key(H, G, L, classical)
3552 code_key, cached_entry, plain_entry = _resolve_start_cache(
3553 plain_key, start_list, lambda e: _single_entry_is_exact(e, need_cws, dstop), trust_start,
3554 lambda e: _merge_start_into_plain(plain_key, e, True), eff_cache_file, verbose
3555 )
3556 eff_dmin, eff_dmax = _seed_bounds_from_entry(eff_dmin, eff_dmax, plain_entry)
3557 if cached_entry is not None:
3558 c_dmin, c_dmax = cached_entry.get("dmin", 0) or 0, cached_entry.get("dmax", 0) or 0
3559 if _single_entry_is_exact(cached_entry, need_cws, dstop):
3560 c_rw = cached_entry.get("rw_steps", 0) or 0
3561 d_info = format_bounds_list(c_dmin, c_dmax, c_rw)
3562 found = "exact distance" if (c_dmin > 0 and c_dmin == c_dmax) else f"dmin={c_dmin} >= dstop={dstop}"
3563 if verbose:
3564 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Cache retrieval: SUCCESS (found cached {found} for '{code_key}')")
3565 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Cached result: dist={_dist_from_bounds(c_dmin, c_dmax)}, "
3566 f"bounds={format_bounds_str(d_info)}")
3567 elif debug & PY_DBG_CACHE:
3568 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Cache hit for {kind} distance ({found} known)!")
3569 cws_res = [list(cw) for cw in cached_entry.get("cws", [])] if need_cws else []
3570 hit = {"dist": _dist_from_bounds(c_dmin, c_dmax), "dmin": c_dmin, "dmax": c_dmax,
3571 "rw_steps": c_rw, "d_info": d_info, "cws": cws_res, "cached": True}
3572 else:
3573 if verbose:
3574 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Cache retrieval: PARTIAL (cached bounds: dmin={c_dmin}, dmax={c_dmax}, "
3575 f"rw_steps={cached_entry.get('rw_steps', 0)}; continuing search)")
3576 eff_dmin, eff_dmax = _seed_bounds_from_entry(eff_dmin, eff_dmax, cached_entry)
3577 elif verbose:
3578 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Cache retrieval: MISS (no entry for '{code_key}')")
3579 except Exception:
3580 code_key = cached_entry = plain_key = plain_entry = hit = None
3581 elif verbose:
3582 print("[dist_m4ri] Cache retrieval: DISABLED (cache is turned off)")
3583 if hit is not None:
3584 hit["cws"] = write_out(hit["cws"])
3585 return hit
3586
3587 if wmax > 0 and eff_dmin > max(wmax, dmin): # a cached lower bound beyond wmax (the binary needs dmin <= wmax)
3588 src = cached_entry or plain_entry
3589 if not (method & 1) and src is not None: # CC only: all weights up to wmax have been analyzed already
3590 c_dmin, c_dmax, c_rw = src.get("dmin", 0) or 0, src.get("dmax", 0) or 0, src.get("rw_steps", 0) or 0
3591 if verbose:
3592 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Cached lower bound dmin={c_dmin} > wmax={wmax}: no CC round needed")
3593 cws_res = write_out([list(cw) for cw in src.get("cws", [])] if need_cws else [])
3594 return {"dist": _dist_from_bounds(c_dmin, c_dmax), "dmin": c_dmin, "dmax": c_dmax, "rw_steps": c_rw,
3595 "d_info": format_bounds_list(c_dmin, c_dmax, c_rw), "cws": cws_res, "cached": True}
3596 eff_dmin = max(wmax, dmin)
3597
3598 temp_files: List[str] = []
3599 try:
3600 def input_file(M: Any, ext: str) -> Optional[str]:
3601 if M is None:
3602 return None
3603 if isinstance(M, (str, Path)) and os.path.exists(str(M)):
3604 return str(M)
3605 path = _matrix_to_file(M, extension=ext)
3606 temp_files.append(path)
3607 return path
3608
3609 file_dem = None
3610 if fdem is not None: # a DEM: the file, or the object written to a temporary file
3611 if isinstance(fdem, (str, Path)) and os.path.exists(str(fdem)):
3612 file_dem = str(fdem)
3613 else:
3614 file_dem = create_unique_file(extension=".dem")
3615 temp_files.append(file_dem)
3616 _write_dem_file(fdem, file_dem)
3617 file_H, file_G, file_L = input_file(H, "_H.mtx"), input_file(G, "_G.mtx"), input_file(L, "_L.mtx")
3618 file_drop = None
3619 if fdem is not None and fdrop is not None: # the detectors to drop: the file, or the list written to a file
3620 if isinstance(fdrop, (str, Path)):
3621 file_drop = str(fdrop)
3622 elif len(fdrop) > 0:
3623 file_drop = create_unique_file(extension="_drop.txt")
3624 temp_files.append(file_drop)
3625 with open(file_drop, "w") as f:
3626 f.write(" ".join(str(r) for r in fdrop) + "\n")
3627 outC_file = None
3628 if need_cws:
3629 outC_file = create_unique_file(extension="_cws.nz")
3630 temp_files.append(outC_file)
3631
3632 dmin_res, dmax_res, rw_steps = run_dist_m4ri(
3633 dist_m4ri_path=dist_m4ri,
3634 method=method,
3635 finH=file_H,
3636 finG=file_G,
3637 finL=file_L,
3638 fdem=file_dem,
3639 finC=finC,
3640 classical=-1 if fdem is not None else (1 if classical else 0),
3641 dmin=eff_dmin,
3642 dmax=eff_dmax,
3643 dstop=dstop,
3644 wmin=wmin,
3645 wmax=wmax,
3646 smax=smax,
3647 start=start_list,
3648 warn_start=False,
3649 warn_ksub=False,
3650 dexp=d_exp,
3651 steps=num_steps,
3652 threads=threads,
3653 timeout=timeout,
3654 pmin=pmin,
3655 merge=merge,
3656 drop=file_drop,
3657 outD=outD if fdem is not None else None,
3658 sort_rows=sort_rows,
3659 dW=dW,
3660 maxC=maxC,
3661 outC=outC_file,
3662 seed=seed,
3663 debug=debug,
3664 nothrottle=nothrottle,
3665 chunk_size=chunk_size,
3666 ksub=ksub,
3667 kwin=kwin,
3668 win_mode=win_mode,
3669 win_hyb=win_hyb,
3670 pairs=pairs,
3671 min_hits=min_hits,
3672 cov_cws=cov_cws,
3673 refresh=refresh,
3674 verbose=verbose
3675 )
3676
3677 cws: List[List[int]] = []
3678 if need_cws and outC_file and os.path.exists(outC_file):
3679 cws = read_sparse_vectors(outC_file)
3680 cws.sort(key=len)
3681
3682 if _use_distance_cache and code_key is not None:
3683 prev = cached_entry or {}
3684 p_dmax = prev.get("dmax", 0) or 0
3685 best_dmax = min(p_dmax, dmax_res) if (p_dmax > 0 and dmax_res > 0) else max(p_dmax, dmax_res)
3686 best_dmin = max(prev.get("dmin", 0) or 0, dmin_res)
3687 total_rw = (prev.get("rw_steps", 0) or 0) + rw_steps
3688 record = _sector_record(best_dmin, best_dmax, total_rw, _union_cws(prev.get("cws", []), cws))
3689 if "dmin_model" in prev: # (a bound from the code-sized model, see compute_model_lower_bound())
3690 record["dmin_model"] = prev["dmin_model"]
3691 _distance_cache[code_key] = record
3692 if plain_key is not None and code_key != plain_key:
3693 # start-list run: merge the valid part (or all, with trust_start) into the main record
3694 _merge_start_into_plain(plain_key, record, trust_start, {"": rw_steps})
3695 if eff_cache_file:
3696 save_distance_cache(eff_cache_file)
3697 res = {"dist": record["dist"], "dmin": record["dmin"], "dmax": record["dmax"], "rw_steps": total_rw,
3698 "d_info": record["d_info"], "cws": record["cws"] if need_cws else [], "cached": False}
3699 else:
3700 res = {"dist": _dist_from_bounds(dmin_res, dmax_res), "dmin": dmin_res, "dmax": dmax_res,
3701 "rw_steps": rw_steps, "d_info": format_bounds_list(dmin_res, dmax_res, rw_steps), "cws": cws,
3702 "cached": False}
3703 res["cws"] = write_out(res["cws"])
3704 return res
3705 finally:
3706 _remove_temp_files(temp_files, debug)
3707

3709def compute_classical_distance(
3710 H: Any,
3711 dist_m4ri: Optional[str] = None,
3712 method: int = 3,
3713 threads: Optional[int] = None,
3714 timeout: float = 60.0,
3715 num_steps: Optional[int] = None,
3716 d_exp: int = 0,
3717 d_min: int = 0,
3718 d_max: int = 0,
3719 dmin: int = 0,
3720 dmax: int = 0,
3721 dstop: int = 0,
3722 wmin: int = 1,
3723 wmax: int = 0,
3724 smax: Optional[int] = None,
3725 start: Optional[Union[int, str, Sequence[int]]] = None,
3726 cbeg: Optional[int] = None,
3727 cend: Optional[int] = None,
3728 noscan: int = 0,
3729 dW: int = -1,
3730 maxC: int = 0,
3731 finC: Optional[str] = None,
3732 outC: Optional[str] = None,
3733 do_cws: bool = False,
3734 return_info: bool = False,
3735 cache_file: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
3736 solver: str = "dist_m4ri",
3737 codedistance_method: str = "QDistEvol",
3738 codedistance_params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
3739 seed: int = 0,
3740 debug: int = 0,
3741 verbose: bool = False,
3742 nothrottle: bool = False,
3743 chunk_size: int = 0,
3744 ksub: int = 0,
3745 kwin: int = 0,
3746 win_mode: int = 0,
3747 win_hyb: int = 0,
3748 pairs: int = -1,
3749 min_hits: Optional[int] = None,
3750 cov_cws: int = 100,
3751 refresh: int = 0,
3752 trust_start: bool = False,
3753 sort_rows: Optional[bool] = None,
3754 **kwargs
3755) -> Any:
3756 """
3757 Computes the minimum distance of a classical linear code given parity check matrix H.
3758
3759 Args:
3760 H: Parity check matrix (numpy array, scipy sparse matrix, or file path).
3761 dist_m4ri: Path to dist_m4ri executable (optional).
3762 method: Solver method (1=RW, 2=CC, 3=Bracketing default).
3763 threads: Maximum number of worker threads (default: all logical CPUs available; subject to throttling).
3764 timeout: Execution timeout in seconds.
3765 num_steps: Maximum RW steps.
3766 d_exp: Expected distance estimate.
3767 d_min / dmin: Known lower bound on distance.
3768 d_max / dmax: Known upper bound on distance.
3769 dstop: Stop target for the lower bound (default: 0 = off): the search ends once CC has certified
3770 dmin >= dstop (method=2 or 3), unless a lighter codeword is found. Unlike dmax, dstop is not an upper
3771 bound, and it is not reported as dmax: d_info = [dmin, w, rw_steps] with dmin >= dstop and the weight w
3772 of the lightest codeword found (0: none). A cached lower bound dmin >= dstop answers the request without
3773 a calculation.
3774 wmin: Minimum distance of interest (terminate early if cw of weight <= wmin is found in RW or CC, default: 1).
3775 wmax: Maximum weight to search in CC.
3776 smax: Maximum syndrome weight for CC confinement profile.
3777 start: Expert option: list of CC start columns (int, comma-separated string "a,b,c", or
3778 sequence of ints; None or -1: all columns). CC clusters are grown only from the listed
3779 columns, and they are not limited to larger column indices. WARNING: the lower bound
3780 (and an exact result) is valid only if a code symmetry maps every minimum-weight codeword
3781 to one containing a listed column (e.g., one column per block of a quasi-cyclic code);
3782 the upper bound is always valid. Results are cached under the separate key
3783 '<key>:start=a,b,c'; only dmax and codewords update the main cache record.
3784 trust_start: Expert option: accept the start-list results as valid, i.e., also merge dmin and
3785 rw_steps into the main cache record, and copy an existing exact start-list record to the
3786 main record even if no calculation is needed (default: False).
3787 cbeg / cend / noscan: Disabled in the Python interface: accepted for backward compatibility,
3788 but ignored with a warning to stderr (use the dist_m4ri binary directly).
3789 sort_rows: Row order of H in the binary (see run_dist_m4ri()): True sorts the rows by increasing weight
3790 (faster CC for very different row weights), False keeps their order, and None (default) leaves the
3791 binary's default (sorted for matrices; the detectors of a DEM are kept in time order). The result and
3792 the cache key do not depend on it.
3793 win_hyb: Window size of the automatic hybrid RW steps (kwin=0, n >= 500: a window on every other step; see
3794 run_dist_m4ri()); 0 (default): 256 columns for a DEM, 512 for matrices. The cache key does not depend on
3795 it.
3796 pairs: The RW pairs of non-pivot columns (p=2, see run_dist_m4ri()): the number of random pivot rows of
3797 their buckets (0: off; -1, the default: auto). The cache key does not depend on it.
3798 ksub: Experimental, should not be used (a warning is printed to stderr for ksub > 0 with method=1 or 3):
3799 subspace dimension sampled from ker(H) in RW (default: 0, full-matrix RW).
3800 dW: Extra weight window above dmin to collect codewords.
3801 maxC: Maximum number of codewords to collect.
3802 finC: Input file with initial codewords.
3803 outC: Output file to save codewords (NZLIST format).
3804 do_cws: Whether to return extracted codewords.
3805 return_info: If True, return (dist, d_info) or (dist, d_info, cws) where d_info is [dmin, dmax, num_rw].
3806 cache_file: Optional JSON file path for persistent distance caching.
3807 solver: "dist_m4ri" or "codedistance".
3808 codedistance_method: Method if using codedistance library.
3809 codedistance_params: Extra parameters for codedistance library.
3810 seed: Random seed.
3811 debug: Debug bitmap: the bits in BIN_DBG_MASK for the dist_m4ri binary, and the PY_DBG_* bits.
3812 verbose: Verbose reporting flag.
3813
3814 Returns:
3815 dist or (dist, cws) if do_cws is True (or (dist, d_info) / (dist, d_info, cws) if return_info=True)
3816
3817 Raises:
3818 TypeError: for an unknown keyword argument (e.g., a misspelled option).
3819 """
3820 eff_dmin = dmin if dmin > 0 else d_min
3821 eff_dmax = dmax if dmax > 0 else d_max
3822 _check_kwargs(compute_classical_distance, kwargs)
3823 start_list = _prepare_start_option(start, trust_start, noscan, cbeg, cend, solver)
3824 _warn_experimental_ksub(ksub, method, solver)
3825
3826 if solver == "codedistance":
3827 if do_cws or outC:
3828 raise ValueError("Codeword extraction is not supported with codedistance solver; use solver='dist_m4ri'.")
3829 codedistance = _get_codedistance()
3830 import numpy as np
3831 params = dict(codedistance_params or {})
3832 if num_steps is not None and "iterCount" not in params:
3833 params["iterCount"] = num_steps
3834
3835 H_mat = H.toarray() if hasattr(H, 'toarray') else (
3836 np.asarray(H, dtype=np.int8) if isinstance(H, (np.ndarray, list)) else None
3837 )
3838 res = codedistance.codeDistance(
3839 H_mat, None, tB=1, method=codedistance_method, params=params,
3840 seed=seed if seed != 0 else None
3841 )
3842 d = res.get("d", -1)
3843 if return_info:
3844 d_info = format_bounds_list(d, d, 0) if d > 0 else [0, 0, 0]
3845 return d, d_info
3846 return d
3847
3848 # Solver is native multithreaded dist_m4ri (supports bounds caching and cumulative RW steps)
3849 eff_cache_file = str(Path(cache_file).resolve()) if cache_file is not None else _distance_cache_file
3850 res = _cached_code_distance(
3851 H, None, None, True, "classical", dist_m4ri=dist_m4ri, method=method, threads=threads, timeout=timeout,
3852 num_steps=num_steps, d_exp=d_exp, dmin=eff_dmin, dmax=eff_dmax, dstop=dstop, wmin=wmin, wmax=wmax,
3853 smax=smax, start_list=start_list, dW=dW, maxC=maxC, finC=finC, outC=outC, need_cws=bool(do_cws or outC),
3854 eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file, seed=seed, debug=debug, verbose=verbose, nothrottle=nothrottle,
3855 chunk_size=chunk_size, ksub=ksub, kwin=kwin if kwin > 0 else int(kwargs.get("win", 0) or 0),
3856 win_mode=win_mode, min_hits=min_hits, cov_cws=cov_cws, refresh=refresh, trust_start=trust_start,
3857 sort_rows=sort_rows, win_hyb=win_hyb, pairs=pairs
3858 )
3859 dist, d_info, cws = res["dist"], res["d_info"], res["cws"]
3860 if return_info:
3861 return (dist, d_info, cws) if do_cws else (dist, d_info)
3862 return (dist, cws) if do_cws else dist
3863
